==Description==
The '''Crystalite''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared exclusively in [[The Heights]] as part of the [[SFOTH Event]]. It had the same speed as the [[Normal Boss]] and [[Necromancer (Legacy Enemy)|Necromancer]]. It also had more health than the [[Necromancer (Legacy Enemy)|Necromancer]] and [[Normal Boss]] (and far more than the [[Stone Viking]]). Upon its death, the '''Crystalite''' would create a small bile bubble, which would stun nearby towers.

==Appearance==
Compared to the average [[Enemies|enemy]], the '''Crystalite''' had quite an unusual design as it had four light grey legs, with three black claws on each. It had a grey neck and a light grey head with white glowing eyes. It had a smile face, but did not have any arms. There were also white glowing horns on the '''Crystalite'''. The '''Crystalite''' had two colored neon crystals on its neck, one being yellow and the other being blue, and a pink crystal chunk on its front left leg.

==Strategy==
*If you can, try to kill the '''Crystalite''' away from towers, so when the '''Crystalite''' is killed, fewer towers will be stunned.
**Long-range towers, such as the [[Ranger|Outlaw]] and [[Militant|John]], can be used as they can be placed away from the path, not getting affected by the '''Crystalite's''' stun.
*The '''Crystalite's''' higher health means that high DPS towers, such as the [[Ranger|Outlaw]] and [[Minigunner]], are recommended.
*The [[Freezer]] and [[Pyromancer]] are useful in slowing down the '''Crystalite'''.
**The [[Freezer]]'s ''Freeze Drop'' ability can be used to slow down hordes of '''Crystalites''', giving more time for your towers to attack it.

==Trivia==
*The '''Crystalite''' was a re-skin of the [[Carrier]] and it performed a similar ability to the [[Carrier]], except that the '''Crystalite''' did not spawn other [[enemies]].
**Both were added at the same time.
*'''Crystalite''' was a portmanteau of the words "crystal" and "stalactite".
